moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-proximity-scramble, written here): Scripted cursor: bottom-left off-frame (0.4 s) → the text's left end, 22 px below centre (0.9 s) → right end (2.5 s) → out top-right (3.0 s). A char within 54 px (recipe 100) scrambles until 1.2 s × (1 − d / R) after its nearest pass (cursor sampled at 30 fps): '.' or ':' (seeded, swapped every 0.08 s) in mono 700 accent over a 55 % ghost of the real char, with an accent bar under it shrinking with the time left. Loop 4.4 s. Params: bán kính (54 px) · thời gian nhiễu tối đa (1.2 s) · bộ ký tự (. :) · nhịp đổi (0.08 s). The pointer is sampled at 30 fps; each scrambled letter shows a seeded symbol over a 55 % ghost of itself, with a bar under it that shrinks with the time left.
